letter.company_line: Engineering consultancy hiring a cadet drafter for its Melbourne team
letter.subject: Cadet Drafter, Melbourne (R2130825)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Cadet Drafter role in Melbourne that KBR posted on its careers site. Setting up drawings and basic 3D models with mentoring from senior designers and engineers is exactly the start I am looking for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I have also modelled in 3D in Revit and AutoCAD. This software use is from coursework rather than commercial production work, and I have not yet used laser scanning, 12d or MicroStation.

Before moving to Australia I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020 as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer. I reviewed drawings, carried out site inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and material records, so I am comfortable with the site visits and field data side of the role.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I would value the chance to talk about the role. I've attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
